mapper.insert: INSERT INTO client_holdings (account_id, instrument_id, quantity, average_cost) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{instrumentId}, #{quantity}, #{averageCost})
mapper.select: SELECT h.account_id, i.ticker AS symbol, h.quantity, h.average_cost FROM client_holdings h JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = h.instrument_id WHERE h.account_id = #{accountId} AND h.quantity > 0 ORDER BY i.ticker
